news.headline: Mass protests sweep France as huge crowds demand higher wages
news.summary: Hundreds of thousands of striking workers protested across France on Thursday, November 5, against the rising cost of living following weeks of youth-led demonstrations, with police firing tear gas as clashes broke out in some cities. FRANCE 24's Emily Boyle reports.

news.headline: California governor says commuting all death sentences in state
news.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom said Thursday, November 5, he was commuting all death sentences across the state to life imprisonment, in a move that will affect over 500 prisoners. FRANCE 24's correspondent Wassim Cornet reports.

news.summary: Five European nations are closing in on a plan to send rejected migrants to Rwanda following a failed U.K. deal with the country.

news.headline: Alberta’s Librarians Brace for a New Era of ‘Book Bans’
news.summary: A new provincial law requires public libraries to pull and restrict items with “graphic visual depictions of sexual acts.” Librarians are worried.

news.summary: The commanding victory of the Democrats has brought private relief to some Europeans but no official glee, with Ukraine, Iran and NATO all hanging in the balance.
